value.policy: Incoming simple dependency paths, breadth first per changed object, before snapshot then after snapshot. Each path runs from the affected object to the changed object; diamonds retain distinct paths and cycles never repeat an object. Only resolved nativeConfirmed/parsedSupported edges with exact captured endpoints are followed. No cross-snapshot edges are joined.
value.limitations: Static dependency review candidates, not runtime effects or a compile verdict. Both captures have incomplete relationship coverage; excluded edges and bounds can hide further paths. Absence from captured scope is not deletion; no paths does not establish no impact.
value.consumerPolicy: Both phases use this same saved review. Roots are the selected TO and exact same-PLC captured objects of declared consumers whose subjects exist in that phase. Incoming saved paths describe context candidates, not effects of proposed parameter/relationship changes. Supplied consumer links are never inserted as captured edges. Other PLCs, virtual nodes, unknown scopes, mismatched and ambiguous identities are excluded. Member existence and native links remain unverified; absent declarations do not prove removal or no impact.
